name: seed_trusted_ai_content_sources
query:
-- Seed the initial trusted sources used by the review-only content workflow.
insert into public.ai_content_sources (name, source_url, language, is_enabled)
values
  ('Hugging Face Blog', 'https://huggingface.co/blog/feed.xml', 'en', true),
  ('Google AI Blog', 'https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/ai/rss/', 'en', true)
on conflict (source_url) do update
set name = excluded.name,
    language = excluded.language,
    is_enabled = true;
